How do you check in groups that booked under one name?

Start with the booking holder and the number of people on each reservation. Add the class date, start time and instructor so two sessions with similar names stay distinguishable. As people arrive, mark the individual guest places under their booking name. Export or print the attendance record when check-in is complete.

Worked example

Morgan has booked four workshop places. Two guests arrive first, so the instructor marks two of Morgan’s four checkboxes. The booking remains visible with two guests still to arrive, while the session attendance total increases by two.

Class Check-In Sheet Generator FAQ

Can I check in one person from a group without marking the whole booking?

Yes. Each participant has a separate checkbox under the reservation name. Mark guests one at a time as they arrive.

Do I need every attendee’s name to make a roster?

You can use a booking holder’s name and group size. If you need named attendance, enter each participant on their own line with a group size of one.

How do I make a blank attendance sheet for an instructor?

Enter the class and group reservations, leave the guest checkboxes clear and use Print / save PDF. The instructor can mark arrivals by hand.

Can I keep a copy of completed attendance?

Export the attendance CSV after marking arrivals. It records the session, booking, guest position, group size and check-in status. You can also print the marked sheet.

What happens if I edit the roster after check-in starts?

Changing the roster or session details can reset the check-in marks. Export the current record before replacing the list or setting up another class.

Does checking a box update my Shopify orders?

Checkmarks belong to this working sheet. Use the exported attendance record to reconcile reservations in the system that holds your orders.
